subject: Costco (COST)
text: Should investors expect another special dividend payment from Costco this year?

subject: Costco (COST)
text: Last year, Costco announced a special dividend of $15 per share, which coincided with the release of its first-quarter results.

subject: Costco (COST)
text: Now, amid more tepid growth and potentially more challenging economic conditions, it may be difficult for Costco to justify making another special dividend payment in December, especially since it made one just last year.
